# Profile: rev.hodl (Karl)

## Identity
rev.hodl ("rev") is a permaculture homesteader on 20 acres in Southwest Michigan who has fused Bitcoin mining, regenerative agriculture, and Nostr-based community building into a unified way of life. He co-hosts the **Local Bitcoiners podcast** (V4V-funded, built as a Nostr client), organizes multiple monthly Bitcoin meetups across MI/Northern Indiana, and sells lamb, seeds, elderberry cuttings, Slim19 space heaters, and homestead goods — all priced in sats. His core thesis: **"Permanent culture requires permanent money; Bitcoin."**

## Expertise
- **Pleb Bitcoin Mining / Heat Reuse** (Expert): Has built 11+ mining-heat applications — dehydrators, clothes dryers, maple sap RO heaters, space heaters, cold frames, lamb incubators, immersion hot water systems ("hash-vide"), an evaporative AC (hackathon finalist), and off-grid solar mining. Sells custom Slim19 heaters to local plebs.
- **Permaculture & Regenerative Ag** (Expert, 10+ yrs): PDC-certified 2016. Rotational grazing of 20-60 Katahdin sheep, food forest design, apple grafting (50+ varieties), chicken composting system, foraging/herbalism, maple sugaring (116 taps scaling to 250).
- **Cannabis Breeding** (Advanced): Developed Redbud Haze, Redbud Widow, Rosegold Leaf, and "!!!" genetics — sungrown, zero external inputs, cold-hardy selection. Sells regular photoperiod seeds for sats.
- **Podcasting 2.0 / V4V** (Advanced): Co-built Local Bitcoiners as a Nostr-integrated podcast platform with boost-triggered meetup promotion bots and guest revenue splits.
- **Bitcoin Privacy** (Intermediate-Advanced): UTXO management via submarine swaps, Lightning-first, anti-KYC advocacy, explored Nostr-based coinjoin coordination.
- **Construction / Off-Grid Solar** (Advanced): Built a 20ft tiny house over 7.5 years from reclaimed materials; installed 2.5kW+ solar system; built rocket mass heater, yurt guest space, mobile stanchions, fencing systems.
- **Integrated Homestead Systems**: Rabbit Colony Cannabis Garden (rabbits fertilize/trim cannabis; cannabis feeds rabbits — ~150 lbs meat/year at near-zero cost).

## Key Beliefs
- **Bitcoin and Permaculture are inseparable.** Bitcoin creates the incentive structures permaculture has tried to establish; "to study nature is to study Bitcoin."
- **Earning > buying; KYC Bitcoin is dangerous.** "Maximal participation is KYC-free participation." Mining and circular economy beat exchange purchases. Local price discovery via meetups reveals Bitcoin's true value.
- **Mining value isn't profit — it's participation, heat, and KYC-free sats.** "It's very difficult to end up with more sats than if you had just hodled." The point is double-spend energy: heat *and* sats *and* product.
- **Nostr is for Bitcoiners.** It's where cultural capital gets built uninhibited; every website will become a Nostr client. Non-Bitcoin Nostr accounts are oxymoronic.
- **Fiat erodes culture, community, and family.** Welfare is "the cantillion effect for poor people." Politicians embracing Bitcoin are setting up Bitcoiners as scapegoats.
- **Modified third permaculture ethic: "Non-Extraction"** instead of "Redistribute Surplus" — failing to redistribute is inherently extractive.

## Notable Contributions
- **9 Forms of Capital framework**: Expanded the permaculture 8 forms to 9 (added "Vital capital" = mental/physical well-being), organized into Physical/Personal/Relational super-forms. Used as decision-making tool for maximizing simultaneous capital accrual per hour spent.
- **Bitcoin Mining Dehydrator + "Double Spend Energy" concept**: $10 build using salvaged S9 parts; inspired multiple Nostr users to replicate. Coined terminology and methodology now used across pleb mining community. Featured on Pod256 as Home Miner of the Week.
- **"The Bitcoin Meetup Is the Farmers Market"**: Demonstrated concept where meetups function as local circular economy nodes. Organizes 2+ monthly meetups (SWMI 3rd Thursday at Dwellers Co-working, Benton Harbor; South Bend 1st Thursday at Lang Lab), drives 2+ hours to attend others.

## Communication Style
Verbose, process-oriented storyteller in original posts (multi-paragraph with photos/videos, heavy hashtagging, Obsidian-drafted). Warm and high-energy in replies — "Yeehaw!", "let's fucking go," "🤙". Generously shares failures alongside successes.

## Recurring Themes
1. Mining heat reuse evolution (S9 → immersion → Slim19 production)
2. Circular economy in practice (spending sats, earning sats, trading lamb for jerky)
3. Meetup building and isolated-bitcoiner outreach
4. Permaculture ethics applied to every system (including Nostr, mining, money)
5. KYC-free living and anti-exchange advocacy

## Relationships
- **@Reed**: Local Bitcoiners podcast co-host
- **@Barnminer**: Trading partner (syrup for jerky), mining community peer
- **Rod & econoalchemist**: Pod256 collaborators who featured him
- **Bill Wilson**: Permaculture Design Course instructor (2016)
- **Jack Spirko**: TSP host who introduced him as "Karl" to broader audience
- Active in CornyChat streams, Permabits monthly livestreams, Lake Satoshi retreat community

## Quirks
- **"DIY or GFY"** — mining motto
- **"Max bidding!"** — when stuffing the dehydrator to capacity
- **"Hash-vide"** — sous-vide cooking with mining immersion oil
- Posts comprehensive **#40hpw** weekly podcast listening lists (40+ hours via Fountain.fm)
- **"I need to take a physics class"** — recurring self-deprecation despite engineering competence
- Calls his Foton tractor "a piece of shit" and "one of the biggest mistakes I've made"
- Affectionately calls his mobile mining unit the **"hillbilly hasher"**
- Frames everything through permaculture ethics — "if something doesn't fit into permaculture ethics and principles, it's probably bullshit"
- 10-20 hashtags per post across consistent taxonomies (#meshtadel #doublespendenergy #circulareconomy #plebminer #selfsovereignty)
- Drafts in Obsidian, posts via Amethyst, drives Zeus wallet

# Profile: Brian Hirschfield ("Phundamentals")

## Identity
Brian Hirschfield is a career actuary (28 years in pensions and annuities) who quit fiat finance around mid-2022 — walking away because the pension discount-rate assumption process was fundamentally corrupt. He now operates full-time as a Bitcoin educator, mathematician, and community builder in Philadelphia, running Magic Internet Math Academy, Philly Bitdevs, and a network of podcasts. His life's work has crystallized around whether Bitcoin fixes insurance or vice versa — and whether mathematics is the pathway to both God and sovereignty.

## Expertise
- **Actuarial science & pension risk** — 28-year career; identifies $200T+ in unfunded US pension liabilities; deep knowledge of LDI failures, CALPERS assumptions, SVB's bond impairment, and AIG's 2008 collapse.
- **Bitcoin monetary theory** — Austrian framework; time preference, Cantillon Effect, halving incentive mechanics, portfolio construction theory, bond market dynamics.
- **Institutional Bitcoin adoption** — authored "Bitcoin for Institutions"; developed thesis that BlackRock's ETF move is a liability play to dump bonds, not accumulate BTC; deep concern about FASB fair value accounting enabling custodial risk.
- **Mathematics education** — built 90+ free courses; 13-part YouTube series on Elliptic Curve Cryptography; views math as a liberal art and path to sovereignty, not vocational training.
- **Cryptography** — self-taught from Jimmy Song's *Programming Bitcoin*; understands secp256k1, ECDSA, Schnorr, MuSig2, finite fields, Discrete Logarithm Problem.
- **Lightning Network** — runs Umbrel and CLI nodes; completed Base58; studies trustless channel mechanics, splicing, liquidity tradeoffs; proposes annuity primitives on Lightning.

## Key Beliefs
- **"There is no such thing as an Orange Pill"** — conviction cannot be transferred; it must be earned through time and effort and tested daily against 8 billion people.
- **Reject Bitcoin moralizers** — "Bitcoin is no more moral than the steel that holds up a bridge." Purity tests are tyranny; valid transactions are the only valid test.
- **Bitcoin is for individual power, not institutional power** — institutions cannot HODL; "HODL'ing is a purely human action." The ETF is "literally designed for slaves."
- **Mathematics is a pathway to God** — understanding God as the identity element of an algebraic structure, where inverses guarantee any action away from God has a corresponding return.
- **Insurance will mostly cease to exist under a Bitcoin standard** — "Nobody knows the true price of risk."
- **The Normal distribution is a psy-op** — systematically underestimates tail risk; Black-Scholes-Merton "destroyed the financialized world."

## Notable Contributions
- **Magic Internet Math Academy** (magicinternetmath.com) — 90+ free courses spanning algebra through ECC, Austrian economics, and FROST signatures, with Nostr-integrated quiz leaderboards.
- **"Building Annuities on the Lightning Protocol"** — original framework proposing Lightning can remove trust from annuity structures, creating cooperation tools unlike anything humanity has seen.
- **Phish-Cypherpunk Theory** — extensive creative framework connecting Phish's music and community to Bitcoin: *Joy* parallels the Genesis block, *555* is the 10-minute block train, Jeff Holdsworth is Satoshi.

## Communication Style
Mixes punchy aphorisms ("Bitcoin neither asks for permission nor forgiveness") with dense, stream-of-consciousness philosophical threads. Uses "Pura Vida!" as a daily greeting, deploys metaphors constantly (Bitcoin as potential/kinetic energy, cholesterol, a bucking bronco), and ranges from dry wit to outright vulgarity.

## Recurring Themes
- Mathematics as the foundation of Bitcoin sovereignty — "WE ARE MATH"
- Conviction: how to build it, test it, maintain the "Conviction Citadel"
- Circular Bitcoin economies building diamond hands
- Fiat system critique: pensions, banking failures, Cantillon Effect
- The spiritual dimension: Bitcoin, math, and God

## Relationships
Collaborates closely with **Business Cat** (Rock Paper Bitcoin co-host), **Rob Hamilton** (Magic Internet Math podcast), **JasonC** (Back on the Chain), and **Otis Bitmeyer** (Sound Coffee). Deeply embedded in Philadelphia's **Bitcoin Jawn** community and the broader Nostr ecosystem — frequent exchanges with plebiANON, rev.hodl, Shadrach, and Pickle Dan. His daughter Kayla is a "real mathematician" studying classical analysis.

## Quirks
- **"Pura Vida!"** as near-daily greeting and sign-off
- Signs posts "- Fundamentals" with links to magicinternetmath.com ("Start here. Study math, be sovereign")
- April Fools' Day is "fiat bullshit"; daylight savings is "fake fiat time"
- 30+ year Phish fan who sees the band as unknowing cypherpunk signal carriers
- Golf handicap tracked in sats; coffee obsession with Chemex at 205°F and Blue Bottle subscription
- Calls diversification "a participation trophy invented by a species who doesn't recognize predators"
- "Fiat Delenda Est" as a sign-off
- Running joke: "Rabbi is short for Rabbit hole"

# Profile: jordan (linkinparkrulz)

## Name & Identity
Jordan is a Bitcoin privacy developer and podcast producer best known as the creator of **Ashigaru** (Terminal and Desktop), a Tor-first Bitcoin wallet with full Whirlpool coinjoin support. He is a core member of the **Ungovernable Misfits** podcast network, where he produces multiple shows including *The Bitcoin Brief*, *Freedom Tech Friday*, *Action News!!!*, and *Monero Monthly*. He operates at the intersection of cypherpunk tooling and value-for-value media, building privacy infrastructure while amplifying it through podcasting.

## Expertise
- **Bitcoin privacy tooling**: Deep expertise in Whirlpool coinjoin implementation, Tor networking, UTXO management (Tx0, Premix, Postmix, Badbank), and mix-to workflows. Built Ashigaru Terminal from the Samourai codebase and then wrapped it in a native desktop GUI.
- **BIP47 payment codes**: Created paymentcode.io as an educational lab and verifier tool. Integrated BIP47 message verification into Ashigaru Desktop for trustless release signing. His Paynym identity (paynym.rs/+linkinparkrulz) serves as his cryptographic release-signing identity.
- **StartOS/Start9 packaging**: Maintains Dojo and Ashigaru packages for StartOS, including community marketplace releases and the v4.0 beta transition. Debugged electrs vs. fulcrum indexer tradeoffs and Bitcoin Core/Knots compatibility issues.
- **Podcasting 2.0 infrastructure**: Runs multi-show podcast network with value-for-value splits via Alby/AlbyHub, boosts, and stream sats. Advocates for cross-app commenting standards and Nostr-integrated podcast engagement.
- **Nostr infrastructure**: Operated his own relay (wss://nostr.supremestack.xyz), integrated NoComment on his personal site, and has tested numerous Nostr clients (Astral, Branle, Iris, Nostrudel, Yakihonne).
- **DIY/self-hosting**: Wrote blog series on building personal websites from scratch with NGINX; experienced with home bitcoin mining (Antminer S9 fan swaps, BraiinsOS+, heat repurposing).

## Key Beliefs & Positions

1. **Privacy is a human right, not a premium feature.** This is literally the tagline of Ashigaru Desktop's release. He believes privacy tooling should be free, open source (GPLv3), and accessible to non-technical users — which is why he built a GUI on top of Terminal.

2. **Anti-lock-in and self-custody absolutism.** "Lock-in is the enemy of self-custody." He pushed for BIP-329 label import/export specifically so users aren't trapped in any single wallet. He celebrates interoperability between Ashigaru, Sparrow, and Foundation devices.

3. **#FREESAMOURAI advocacy.** He is a vocal, sustained supporter of Samourai Wallet's developers (Bill and Keonne), directing 10% of podcast splits to their legal defense fund via p2prights. He views the prosecution as an attack on open-source privacy coders generally. He openly calls detractors like "Darth the Derp" to be shamed and ostracized.

4. **Skepticism of Bitcoin Core/consensus politics.** He has mocked Core contributors, shared critical memes, and referenced TDev's long-standing critique that exchanges function as a de facto, custodial Layer

# Profile: aljaz

**Identity:** aljaz is a Slovenian systems engineer, infrastructure operator, and anarcho-capitalist builder operating at the intersection of Bitcoin, Lightning, Nostr, AI, and confidential computing. He runs an ecosystem of public-good Nostr infrastructure (nostr.net gateways, relays, search, directories), co-founded Lightning monitoring service Bolt Observer, and is a leading voice for sovereign engineering and freedom tech. He operates under his real identity and brings 15+ years of sysadmin experience to a space dominated by nyms.

**Expertise:**
- **Infrastructure & DevOps (deepest):** 15+ years Linux sysadmin; runs multiple high-traffic Nostr gateways (14M+ requests/21 days), strfry relays, and monitoring systems across Azure, Hetzner, and Cloudflare.
- **Confidential Computing / TEE (flagship):** Deployed first Cashu mint in a Trusted Execution Environment (AMD SEV-SNP); authored comprehensive TEE guides; maintains confidentialinference.net with attestation verification.
- **AI/LLM Engineering:** Runs local models on RTX A5000; built multi-agent orchestration tools (clanker-control, opencode-orchestrator), Mango (confidential AI app), and whisper-talk; wrote guide fitting 262K context Gemma on 16GB VRAM.
- **Bitcoin & Lightning:** Running Lightning nodes since 2019; deep knowledge of LND/CLN/LDK tradeoffs, liquidity economics, UTXO management; built Verso (stealth BTC transactions in Rust).
- **Nostr Protocol:** Maintains awesome-nostr (400+ projects, 2168+ stars) since January 2022; operates relays, WoT filtering, search engine, and multiple gateways.
- **Cybersecurity:** Professional offensive security background; built IMSI catcher proof-of-concept; deep CVE/vulnerability knowledge; lockpicking and SDR hobbies.
- **Cypherpunk Philosophy:** Maintains cryptoanarchy.info; deeply read in Paul Rosenberg, Galambos, and the cypherpunk canon.

**Key Beliefs:**
- **All taxation is extortion and government is illegitimate** — core anarcho-capitalist conviction; advocates parallel counter-economic structures over reform.
- **"Hodl is the biggest psyop"** — argues it pacified cypherpunk rebels who should've been building parallel systems; Bitcoin is savings technology and liberation tool, not an investment vehicle.
- **Bitcoin co-optation is a deliberate 21-step process** — wrote a detailed playbook (August 2024) tracing how BTC gets absorbed into the state apparatus via regulation, ETFs, and eventual CBDC transformation.
- **TEE/attestation should be default infrastructure** for all freedom tech, not just well-funded projects like Signal — "it's not a panacea, it's just better than what we have now."
- **Grants produce proofs-of-concept lacking market feedback** — favors small-business-loan-style capital that forces builders to find product-market fit.
- **"You SHOULD just do things"** — bias for action elevated to moral imperative; passivity is a failing.

**Notable Contributions:**
- **awesome-nostr / nostr.net ecosystem** — the canonical Nostr project directory since Jan 2022, grown to 400+ projects with global localized gateways.
- **First Cashu mint in a TEE** with verifiable attestation — flagship demonstration of confidential computing for ecash.
- **The 21-Step Bitcoin Co-optation Playbook** — widely cited original framework predicting Bitcoin's regulatory capture trajectory.

**Communication Style:** Concise and meme-heavy when joking; extremely detailed and technically precise when explaining infrastructure or philosophy. Mixes cypherpunk manifestos with shitposting in the same hour. Unfiltered profanity deployed strategically. Latin phrases and literary references woven into technical threads.

**Recurring Themes:** Freedom tech and sovereignty; confidential computing as civilizational defense; anti-passivity / builder ethos; Nostr as infrastructure (not just social media); government overreach and surveillance criticism.

**Relationships:** Closest collaborator is @gsovereignty (Sovereign Engineering); regular collaborators include @BITKARROT, @fiatjaf, @calle, @jb55, @Gigi, and the ContextVM crew. Paul Rosenberg is his primary intellectual influence. Sustained public feud with NVK/Coinkite. Considers Sovereign Engineering SEC-01 "the best thing I did last year."

**Quirks:** "Someday is not a day of the week"; "Freedom maximalist" bio; "days since procrastinating by optimizing my desk layout: 0"; "I clearly don't have enough projects"; calls the EU "EUSSR"; self-identifies as contrarian (Ubuntu→Fedora switch); dog photo enthusiast; carnivore diet advocate; quit both alcohol and coffee exploring sobriety; sauna purist ("is it really a sauna if swimming suits are required?").

# Profile: Avi Burra (@AviBurra)

**Identity**
Avi Burra is a former Fortune 100 health-tech AI/product leader who left corporate life on July 4, 2025 ("Independence Day") to pursue independent work across Bitcoin, Nostr, AI, and creative writing. He's a published novelist, podcast host, protocol builder, and self-described "Chronicler of the Sovereign Age | Anarcho Surrealist" who lives in the mountains of upstate New York. He serves as a cultural anchor of the Nostr community—equal parts philosopher, shitposter, builder, and literary voice.

**Expertise**
- **Bitcoin & Lightning (deep)**: Uncompromising maximalist who prefers "fundamentalist." Runs a Lightning node ("TheHallucinogenicToreador"), understands UTXO mechanics, Schnorr, channel rebalancing, and Austrian monetary theory. Entered through shitcoining (lost 10+ BTC), considers being humbled by Bitcoin his most important life lesson.
- **Nostr protocol (builder level)**: Co-founded NosFabrica. Deep knowledge of NIPs, relay architecture, DVMs, NWC, Blossom. Organized hackathons and built WoT infrastructure. Argues "Nostr moved user identity from the application layer into the protocol layer."
- **AI/LLMs (deep)**: Former corporate AI team leader. Pioneered vibe coding before Karpathy coined the term. Tests models extensively (o3, Claude, DeepSeek). Argues traditional PDLC/Agile is dead—vibe in a day, ship the next.
- **Healthcare technology**: NosFabrica builds health data interoperability on Nostr using credential issuance and contextual WoT for provider discovery.
- **Creative writing**: Published "24" (first full-length Bitcoin novel, with a hidden seed phrase bounty solved at 17M+ sats), sequel "July 18," and "Waiting for Satoshi" (possibly first FOSS play, CC BY-SA on GitHub).
- **Podcasting**: Co-hosts Plebchain Radio (160+ episodes) with QW/Ser Sleepy, plus Sunday Brunch and Say WoT? Interviewed Jeff Booth, ODELL, Guy Swann.
- **Music/V4V**: Progressive metal aficionado curating independent musicians with 90% revenue splits. Authored "Bitcoin is Metal."

**Key Beliefs**
- **Bitcoin fundamentalism**: "Bitcoin is a magic machine that consumes fear, anger, and despair and produces hope, love, and joy." Views ETFs skeptically (adding counterparty risk to a pristine asset). Supports ossification. Ordinals shifted from opposition to neutral acceptance of blockspace markets, though he argues individual satoshis are abstractions, not discrete objects.
- **Nostr as cultural upstream**: "Bitcoin Twitter was a lie." Predicts narrative formation migrates from Twitter to Nostr. "Everyone gets nostr at the censorship they deserve."
- **AI accelerationism with hyperdeflation**: Models will be open source, compute commoditized. "If your job can be automated, it should and will be. Embrace the liberation." Warns of "inference hangover" when venture-subsidized compute ends.
- **Moral clarity → happiness**: Bitcoin meetups and Nostr are happiest places because moral clarity enables peace. "Happiness is highly infectious and nostr is creating a pandemic."
- **Bitcoin renaissance**: Postmodern synthesis will be "unconstrained aspiration to beauty." When money is fixed, what remains is the pursuit of beauty.
- **Zaps over likes**: "Likes can disappear, but zaps never can." Created the "law of zaptraction."

**Notable Contributions**
- **"24"**: 137,000-word surreal novel following Oliver Battolo through grief and Bitcoin discovery, with a hidden 24-word seed phrase bounty that grew to 17M+ sats (solved by @Tufty Sylvestris).
- **NosFabrica**: Health data interoperability on Nostr, co-founded with Jon Gordon and Vitor Pamplona, using Nostr-native credential issuance and contextual WoT for provider directories.
- **Plebchain Radio**: 160+ episode podcast network grown from Nostr Nests to sovereign streaming infrastructure, featuring interviews, V4V music hangs, and WoT deep-dives.
- **"Finding Home"**: Documentary series on Bitcoiners living outside their countries of origin, directed by Kyle Huber/@webworthy, premiered at Bitcoin FilmFest Warsaw.

**Communication Style**
Alternates between terse shitposts ("*Taps mic* Bitcoin is good") and extraordinarily verbose literary essays
